apps.localizedDescription:
Overview:

Tatakai brings anime discovery, streaming, manga reading, and community features together in one customizable app. Instead of relying on a single built-in provider, its extension-first design lets users choose their sources.

Host your own sources with Tatakai Extension Server: setup, built-in proxy, live logs, and deployment buttons for Vercel, Cloudflare, Heroku and Render. Set its API in Settings → Extension Hub → Extension Servers, or configure a connection.

The service is maintained independently in Snozxyx/TatakaiServer and included here as the tatakai-server/ Git submodule. Initialize it in an existing checkout:

For a new Tatakai checkout, use git clone --recurse-submodules.
